quote: Condensing a vast collection of texts into comprehensible summaries is a crucial and challenging task. Timeline summarization (TLS) represents a specialized topic within this area, focusing on distilling event narratives from many texts to summarize the development of specific events or topics over time.

We propose LLM-TLS, a novel approach that harnesses large language models (LLMs) for the incremental generation and summarization of timelines... Timeline summarization is achieved by fine-tuning the LLM with the CrisisLTLSum training set... The LLM is provided with a context consisting of relevant tweets only for each timeline.
